i.norm: Verifies that subtracting a duration from a TaiInstant correctly adjusts both the nanosecond field and the seconds field. The base instant is created with a negative nano adjustment (-1194 ns), which causes normalization: seconds become 3599999999999 and nanos become 999998806. Subtracting 20 ms (20,000,000 ns) reduces only the nano field, yielding 979998806 ns while the seconds component remains unchanged at 3599999999999.
Subtracting 20 ms (20,000,000 ns) from 999,998,806 ns stays within the same second
